summary: Tested the Client Tax Invoice feature end to end, plus GM pending and the Purchase WO action row. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. Covered the inv_ counter (starts at 49, +1 per save, 400 for bad keys, 401 without login), non-admin create/submit allowed, non-admin approve/delete/modify-approved returns 403, SuperAdmin approve sets approvedByName/approvedAt on the server (client-sent value ignored), list persistence and delete. UI (SuperAdmin, 1920px): Saving with no client and with no items both show error toasts. UP client gives CGST+SGST; 10 x 100 @18% shows Taxable 1000, CGST 90, SGST 90, Total 1180. MH (GST 27) client gives IGST 180. First save gives A/E/INV/00049/2627 (clean counter) and the second gives A/E/INV/00050/2627. After save the form is in view mode (inputs disabled). Edit re-enables it, and re-saving keeps the same number. Submit moves it to Submitted and Final Approval moves it to Approved. Print-with window has TAX INVOICE, the company header (.hdr/logo), client name and invoice no. Print-without window has no .hdr or img, has a 75mm top space and still has the TAX INVOICE table. The Excel export downloads Client_Tax_Invoice_Register.xlsx. inv-table lists invoices and inv-open-<id> loads them. Workflow strip crm-flow-10/11/12 show the right counts and crm-flow-11 opens the invoice tab. GM /gm pending table showed the submitted invoice with Approve/Reject, and Reject worked (row disappeared). The WO action row is on one line (9 buttons, all on the same line).

minor.issue: Any write user (non-admin) can still overwrite a Submitted (step 2) invoice's amounts/lines via the API, or send it back to step 1. Only step>=3 is locked. Same pattern as other CRM WF collections.

ui_bugs.issue: Buttons are on one line, but the row overflows by ~13px at 1920 (scrollWidth 1041 > clientWidth 1028), so a horizontal scrollbar appears and 'Delete WO' sits on the edge. Reduce gap/padding or button padding slightly.

integration_issues.issue: gm-crm-go-<i> for a Client Tax Invoice opens /client-revenue on the Dashboard tab, not the invoice tab or record (same for other types).

issues: Client dropdown labels start with ' · ' when a client has no clientCode/tempRefId (e.g. '· TEST UP Client'); hide the separator when there is no code.
Error toasts pile up (an earlier 'Bill To' toast is still showing with the 'items' toast); minor.

action_items: Optional: lock step-2 (Submitted) invoices against non-admin edits on the backend
Optional: trim the wo-action-row width so it doesn't overflow by ~13px at 1920
Optional: GM Review should deep-link to the invoice tab

Decide whether to reset counters.crm.inv_2627 (now 52 because of testing; the next real invoice would be A/E/INV/00053/2627). If the client's first real invoice must be 00049, $unset inv_2627 before go-live.
critical_code_review_comments: Invoices.jsx persist(): the invoice number is taken from the counter before save; if save fails, that serial is lost (gap in the series). Acceptable but worth noting.
Invoices.jsx: `client` is a new `{}` on each render when no client is picked, so the useMemo for computeInvoice runs every render (harmless).
Backend next-number: $max then $inc are two operations; fine in practice, and the floor is correctly per-FY key (inv_YYYY).
printInvoice falls back to a hardcoded company GSTIN/PAN when company settings are empty; make sure company settings have the GST/PAN set.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (minor polish issues only)

seed_data_creation: TEST_cl1 (UP) and TEST_cl2 (MH) clients plus 2 UI invoices and 1 API invoice were created and all deleted. The test key counters.crm.inv_9900 was unset. Final counters.crm = {inv_2627: 52}.

The app clock shows 2026-10-22, so the FY code is 2627. Sel is a native select (use select_option).
